title: TicketFlow event envelope
description: Every message on every TicketFlow topic uses this envelope. Consumers can therefore route, deduplicate and trace a message without knowing anything about its payload. The Kafka record key is always the orderId, so all events about one order land on the same partition and stay ordered.

eventId.description: Unique per message. This is the deduplication key stored in the consumers' processed_events table/collection.

eventVersion.description: Schema version of `data`. Bump it for breaking changes and keep consumers reading both versions during the migration.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened in the producing service - not when it was published.

traceId.description: OpenTelemetry trace id, propagated end to end so one purchase is a single trace across all three services (phase 3).

correlationId.description: Business correlation, normally the orderId. Handy when reading raw messages in Kafka UI.
